newsitem.title: JAPAN: MITSUI MARINE, OTHERS ACCEPT MITSUI CON PLAN.
newsitem.headline: MITSUI MARINE, OTHERS ACCEPT MITSUI CON PLAN.

text.p: Mitsui Marine & Fire Insurance Co Ltd said on Wednesday that it, Sakura Bank Ltd and two other financial institutions belonging to the Mitsui group had decided to accept a restructuring plan submitted to them by Mitsui Construction Co Ltd's.
The plan includes financial support for Mitsui Construction by the other Mitsui group companies, a Mitsui Marine spokesman said.
The other two financial institutions are Mitsui Trust & Banking Co Ltd and Mitsui Mutual Life Insurance Co, a Mitsui Marine spokesman said.
The Mitsui Marine spokesman said that details of the support to the ailing construction firm by the four companies, all of which are members of the Mitsui group, had not yet been decided.

A spokesman at Sakura Bank also said that the bank would support the construction company. He said that some other Mitsui group members, including Mitsui Fudosan Co Ltd, would help the builder in its restructuring efforts.
